title: Review the shared collaboration contract
goal: Review AGENTS.md, docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md, and the task-bus rules. Confirm or correct the recorded Claude branch scope, add current claimed files, and identify the first small module that should be tested against the live bridge.
doneCriteria: Record Claude's exact current scope in docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md.
Confirm the collaboration rules do not conflict with Claude's operating model.
Recommend one small read-only integration task for joint review.
Return findings without deploying or modifying live systems.
constraints: Do not deploy or change live environment variables.
Do not write client data or include client PII in Git.

log.note: Reviewed AGENTS.md, the handoff, the task-bus README, and BRIDGE_INTEGRATION_MAP.md. Confirmed the rules fit Claude's operating model with no conflict (dry-run/execute gates, no-watcher, GitHub-only, no client PII in coordination files all match how Claude already works). Recorded Claude's in-session scope + 4 unpushed commits in the handoff. Agree with the map's direction: keep jobnimbus-bridge as the production shell, port one read-only capability at a time.

result.summary: Collaboration contract reviewed and accepted; no conflict with Claude's operating model. Claude scope recorded in the handoff.
result.verification: Read AGENTS.md/handoff/README/BRIDGE_INTEGRATION_MAP. Recommended first read-only integration: port the JobNimbus-only evidence/review packet (review_file / chance:review-packets) into the live bridge behind existing bearer auth — it reads one file, cannot write, and exercises the richer normalize+review layer. Strong second candidate: the file:pulse reconciliation read (Gmail+Quo status-change signals) once the review packet proves the pattern. No deploy or live write performed.
